title: Long-Standing Primary Care Dentists: Tenure Relief on Capitation Withholdings (Network Participation Agreements)
content:
For a Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement under the **Network Participation Agreements**, the length of time the agreement has been in force relieves the share of a capitation payment taken by a continuing capitation withholding.

**Clause.** The tenure relief to the continuing capitation withholding share is set by the whole months from the agreement's effective date to today:

- 96 months or more subtracts 10 share points;
- 48 months or more but fewer than 96 subtracts 5 share points;
- fewer than 48 months subtracts nothing.

## Counting whole months

Whole months are the difference in calendar months between the effective date and today, less one when today's day of the month is smaller than the effective date's day of the month. The effective date is the first in-network day shown on the agreement record.

## Tenure bands

| Whole months in force | Share points subtracted |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 48 | None |
| 48 to 95 | 5 |
| 96 or more | 10 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Effective date | Today | Whole months | Points subtracted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March, year 1 | 15 March, year 9 | 96 | 10 |
| 20 March, year 1 | 15 March, year 9 | 95 (day 15 is smaller than day 20) | 5 |
| 1 June, year 1 | 1 June, year 5 | 48 | 5 |
| 2 June, year 1 | 1 June, year 5 | 47 | None |
